tables.name: Recent History
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. What has happened in or to the city within the last year. The book's entries have no names; each has a short title, in the book's order.

results.name: Construction Collapse
results.description: Some element of city-sponsored construction collapsed, and several people have been killed.

results.name: Market Hooligans
results.description: A gang of hooligans have started making trouble around the market.

results.name: Tavern Burned
results.description: Adventurers visiting the city started a bar brawl, and the tavern they were in was burned down.

results.name: Incredible Contraption
results.description: An inventor in the city came up with an incredible contraption that has dramatically impacted the lives of the city’s residents.

results.name: Storms
results.description: Ongoing heavy thunderstorms or blizzards are wracking the city.

results.name: New Craze
results.description: A visitor to the city brought something with them that has started a new craze or fashion.

results.name: Visiting Representative
results.description: The city received word recently that a representative from a neighboring kingdom will be visiting. They should be arriving any day.

results.name: Mystery Illness
results.description: Some form of illness has been sweeping through the city, and none are sure what it is, or how it started.

results.name: Broken Gate
results.description: The city’s main gate has broken and needs extensive repairs. In the meantime, the gate is open and additional guards are needed to staff it at all times. If guards are not available, citizens may have been called.

results.name: Calls for New Leadership
results.description: A group of citizens are calling for a new form of leadership. How do others in the city respond?

results.name: Inedible Cuisine
results.description: An item of local cuisine has suddenly been rendered inedible. Whatever is causing the problem seems to be persisting.

results.name: Mysterious Contest
results.description: An unusual, and intriguing, contest is being held by a major figure in the community. Tryouts began a week ago, but none that have participated have mentioned what it is, whether or not they succeeded, or what’s next.

results.name: Fantastic Yield
results.description: A particular resource, that is very important to the city, has had fantastic yield.

results.name: Inflation
results.description: Large amounts of adventurers frequenting the city, lately, has caused massive inflation.

results.name: Sudden Fame
results.description: Someone within the city has recently gained incredible fame.

results.name: Illegal Goods
results.description: Illegal substances, or goods, have been making appearances around the city, but their origin remains undiscovered.

results.name: Taxes Raised
results.description: Taxes have just been raised.

results.name: Taxes Abolished
results.description: Taxes have just been abolished.

results.name: Neighbor Attacked
results.description: A neighboring kingdom has been attacked. The city leadership is deciding what, if anything, to do about it.

results.name: Divine Appearance
results.description: A deity has made a physical appearance in the city.
